text: A healthy lifestyle is about more than just avoiding illness; it’s about feeling your best every day. The foundation starts with a balanced diet, which means eating plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains while limiting processed foods and sugar. Regular exercise, even just a 30-minute walk, keeps your heart strong and your mind sharp. However, don’t underestimate the power of sleep; getting seven to eight hours of quality rest helps your body recover and manage stress. Equally important is your mental health. Taking time for yourself and maintaining a healthy work-life balance prevents burnout and boosts your mood. By focusing on these simple habits, you can build a happier, more energetic life.
